verdict.rationale: Community Phone documents a few fixed, event-driven behaviors that users can configure: calls roll to other numbers when the first isn't answered, missed calls trigger alerts, and users can set call routing, forwarding and blocking. These are narrow telephony settings, not a general rules engine that lets users define their own triggers and actions. The automated check-in calls are a scheduled feature, not an event trigger, so they don't count here. Missing for 10: a general user-defined rule/trigger-action builder, custom event types and actions beyond call routing, any API or webhook-driven automation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
